active_protocol.evidence: build.prop in system.img; ICSmsManager.handleSMS_CMD maps jiai=0 beehome=1 ic=2 fzd=3 mqtt=4
active_protocol.handler_note: 53 is the CMD_TYPE enum. Only 45 downlink opcodes have a handleBP* method; BP10 BP21 BP49 BP92 BPH1 BPHT BPJK BPVR are enum entries with no handler, so the watch parses them and does nothing. Count handlers, not enum entries, when asking what the watch will act on.

protocol_index_map.note: gator / s123 (Vitrack) / anan also compiled in; indices 5-7 reachable by property, mapping unconfirmed

semantics_recovered.BPX1: set HR / BP / SpO2 correction values
semantics_recovered.AP05/BP05: voice messages waiting on the server ('the server has N voice messages not received')
semantics_recovered.AP07/BP07: voice / media packet and its acknowledgement (SentVoicePacket, totalPackageCount, currentPackage); this, not BP42, advances an upload
semantics_recovered.AP68/BP68: device binding / activation state ('bound successfully' / 'not activated or unbound')
semantics_recovered.APHP/BPHP: heart rate + blood pressure + SpO2 upload
semantics_recovered.APJZ/BPJZ: blood-pressure calibration: BPH, BPL, Age, Sex per index. The earlier reading, 'blood pressure systolic and diastolic', took the BPH/BPL pair for a measurement; the Age and Sex fields alongside them and the dispatcher's own branch text make it the calibration command.
semantics_recovered.APU8/BPU8: text-message tunnel; also carries the photo trigger '>*photo@1*<'
semantics_recovered.APTE/BPTE: body-temperature measurement period, in minutes ('measure body temperature once every N minutes'). The handler misreports its own parse failure as 'BP89 format error!'
semantics_recovered.APSQ/BPSQ: vital-sign sensor measurement period, in seconds, per sensor type: heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, blood oxygen. Finer-grained than BP86, which sets only heart rate and blood pressure.
semantics_recovered.APTQ/BPTQ: weather push: weather text, id, current / max / min temperature; broadcasts com.ic.action_weather_recveived

sms_channel.count_note: 36, not the 34 recorded earlier: #ip#= and #TP#= were missed. Both are handled in ICSmsManager.handleSMS_CMD like the rest.

runtime_evidence_appops.WIFI_SCAN + NEIGHBORING_CELLS: same cadence as GPS - WiFi/cell positioning also in use
